Section Five: Explanation According to the Text. Part Three: Translation and Transmission. (2) First, the Presentation of the Chapters. (3) The third section consists of two parts: first, the presentation of the chapters; second, the detailed explanation according to the text. Regarding the first part, the presentation of the chapters, there are three sections: first, the general introduction; second, the specific analysis; and third, the concluding summary. As for the first, the general introduction, it is divided into two parts: first, the title; second, the homage. Regarding the title, there are three points: first, the meaning of the title; second, the reason for the title; and third, the explanation of the title. Regarding the first, the meaning of the title, there are two aspects: first, the meaning of the title as a whole; second, the meaning of each individual term within the title. Regarding the first, the meaning of the title as a whole, it is called the *Mahāyāna-samparigraha-śāstra* because this treatise is able to fully encompass the Mahāyāna teachings. Regarding the second, the meaning of each individual term within the title, there are three points: first, the meaning of "Mahāyāna"; second, the meaning of "Samparigraha" (Comprehensive Uplift); and third, the meaning of "Śāstra" (Treatise). Regarding the first, the meaning of "Mahāyāna," there are two points: first, the etymological definition; second, the classification of its types. Regarding the second, the meaning of "Samparigraha," there are two points: first, the etymological definition; second, the distinction between the subject and the object. Regarding the third, the meaning of "Śāstra," there are two points: first, the etymological definition; second, the distinction between the provisional and the definitive. Regarding the second, the reason for the title, there are two points: first, the reason for the title in relation to the subject matter; second, the reason for the title in relation to the author. Regarding the third, the explanation of the title, there are two points: first, the explanation of the title in relation to the subject matter; second, the explanation of the title in relation to the author. Regarding the second, the homage, there are two points: first, the purpose of the homage; second, the actual content of the homage. Regarding the second, the specific analysis, there are three parts: first, the analysis of the introductory chapter; second, the analysis of the main body of the treatise; and third, the analysis of the concluding chapter. Regarding the first, the analysis of the introductory chapter, there are two parts: first, the analysis of the verses of praise; second, the analysis of the verses of dedication. Regarding the second, the analysis of the main body of the treatise, there are five chapters: first, the chapter on the nature of reality; second, the chapter on the awakening of the mind; third, the chapter on the practice of the path; fourth, the chapter on the stages of attainment; and fifth, the chapter on the ultimate fruit. Regarding the third, the analysis of the concluding chapter, there are two parts: first, the analysis of the verses of conclusion; second, the analysis of the verses of transmission. This concludes the presentation of the chapters. Now, for the second part, the detailed explanation according to the text, there are five sections corresponding to the five chapters of the treatise. Each section shall be explained in turn according to the text. This concludes the first part, the presentation of the chapters. Now, for the second part, the detailed explanation according to the text, there are five sections. Section One: Explanation of the Chapter on the Nature of Reality. Section Two: Explanation of the Chapter on the Awakening of the Mind. Section Three: Explanation of the Chapter on the Practice of the Path. Section Four: Explanation of the Chapter on the Stages of Attainment. Section Five: Explanation of the Chapter on the Ultimate Fruit. Section One: Explanation of the Chapter on the Nature of Reality. This concludes the second part, the detailed explanation according to the text. Now, for the third part, the concluding summary, there are two points: first, the summary of the meaning of the treatise; second, the summary of the benefits of the treatise. Now, for the third part, the translation and transmission, there are two sections: first, the record of the translation; second, the record of the transmission. Regarding the first, the record of the translation, there are three points: first, the date of the translation; second, the names of the translators; and third, the colophon regarding the verification of the text. Regarding the second, the record of the transmission, there are two points: first, the lineage of the masters who transmitted the teaching; second, the record of the disciples who received the instruction.
